elements_selected.content:
Add verbose logging and polish error messages across all theme operations per OBS-014-001, OBS-014-002.

Install verbose output (--verbose or -v):
  - Resolved git URL
  - Ref and resolved commit SHA
  - Clone duration (ms)
  - Number of files copied
  - Total size of installed theme (bytes)
  - Min zetl version warning if applicable

Template resolution verbose output (already partially in place from task-three-tier-resolution):
  - Ensure all three tiers are logged distinctly
  - Format: 'theme: <template> <- <source> (<tier>)'

Error message improvements:
  - All error messages should include actionable hints
  - Network errors: suggest checking connectivity
  - Repo not found: show the resolved URL that was tried
  - Name collision: show --force flag
  - Invalid name: show sanitised suggestion
  - Missing git: show install instructions per platform
